definitions.short: Jaddua , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3037. Yaddua יַדוּעַ proper name, masculine 1. a chief of the people , one of those sealed Neh 10:22 ᵐ5 L Ιεδδαυα . 2 a priest , probably the high priest in time of Alexander the Great Neh 12:11 , 22 ᵐ5 Ιαδου, ᵐ5 L Ιεδδου (whence Lag BN 113 reads יִדּוּעַ ).
